2607.24991.title: Preliminary Guidelines for Using and Evaluating GenAI Tools to Support Systematic Literature Reviews
2607.24991.paper_summary: Context: Generative AI (GenAI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for academic tasks in software engineering and beyond, including systematic literature reviews (SLRs). However, while capable of summarizing text, there is no guarantee they can meet the rigour, reliability, and transparency that SLRs require. Objectives: To support researchers intending to conduct SLRs using GenAI or those conducting empirical studies evaluating how well GenAI supports SLR tasks. Methods: First, we conducted a rapid review to identify studies that propose guidelines for evaluating and using GenAI and LLMs to support SLRs. Second, we drew on thought experiments, relevant guidance from the literature, and our own experience conducting SLRs and evaluating tools to develop recommendations for how to use and assess GenAI in the context of SLRs. Results: We discuss the problems researchers face when evaluating GenAI for SLRs. We identify and explain process issues to consider when planning, conducting, and reporting both SLRs using GenAI and evaluations of GenAI tools. Finally, we summarize our results as a set of process recommendations, which we name GUEST (GenAI Use and Evaluation in SLR Tasks). Conclusion: We argue that GenAI requires human oversight and is not currently capable of unsupervised systematic studies. However, it offers the prospect of cost-effective assistance for some repetitive tasks and for additional validation of some complex tasks. Our GUEST recommendations should help software engineering researchers both to conduct and report trustworthy SLRs using GenAI and to provide rigorous independent evaluation studies.
2607.24991.paper_summary_zh: 背景：生成式人工智慧（GenAI）和大型語言模型（LLMs）在軟體工程及其他領域的學術任務中越來越多地被使用，包括系統文獻回顧（SLRs）。然而，儘管它們能夠總結文本，但無法保證能滿足SLRs所需的嚴謹性、可靠性和透明度。<lb/>目標：支持打算使用GenAI進行SLRs的研究者或那些進行實證研究評估GenAI如何支持SLR任務的研究者。<lb/>方法：首先，我們進行了一項快速回顧，以識別提出評估和使用GenAI及LLMs以支持SLRs的指導方針的研究。<lb/>其次，我們借助思想實驗、文獻中的相關指導以及我們自己進行SLRs和評估工具的經驗，制定了在SLRs背景下使用和評估GenAI的建議。<lb/>結果：我們討論了研究者在評估GenAI用於SLRs時面臨的問題。我們識別並解釋了在規劃、執行和報告使用GenAI的SLRs以及對GenAI工具的評估時需要考慮的過程問題。<lb/>最後，我們將結果總結為一組過程建議，稱之為GUEST（GenAI在SLR任務中的使用與評估）。<lb/>結論：我們認為GenAI需要人類的監督，並且目前無法進行無監督的系統研究。然而，它為某些重複性任務和某些複雜任務的額外驗證提供了成本效益高的協助前景。我們的GUEST建議應能幫助軟體工程研究者使用GenAI進行可信的SLRs，並提供嚴謹的獨立評估研究。
